context: Round-3 R1 (single-turn) catch-up generation for 21 new models, 2026-06-09.
decision: Drop 5 completion scenarios uniformly from R1 analysis (all models, incumbents included) for an unbiased comparison.
rationale: These 5 are the longest/most-expensive completion scenarios. Every one of the 21 catch-up models failed on them with HTTP 402 (the per-request max cost exceeded the remaining OpenRouter balance at run time). Because the failure is identical across all models, excluding the scenarios is unbiased; recovering them would cost disproportionately for 5/58 cells.

note_scattered_transient_errors.description: 12 additional transient errors across 10 scenarios (1-2 models each), not systematic. Left as-is — affected models simply have 1-2 fewer scenarios; not excluded, negligible random noise.

venice_dropped: venice_dolphin_24b excluded from all rounds — OpenRouter :free endpoint rate-limited to 0/20 even at concurrency=1. 40 usable models in round 3.
